I am a NYS Licensed Wildlife Rehabilitator, since April 6, 2026, and this channel is a documentary to share my journey in wildlife rehab, which begins with two female squirrels approximately 2 weeks old. 

I hope you will subscribe , enjoy learning what wildlife rehabilitators do, learn a thing or two along the way about the wildlife, and support my efforts! 

Wildlife rehabilitators are licensed volunteers. We are not paid for the work we do. There is no state or government funding. We do this work because we care and want to help wildlife in need.
